note: Never staged into a run. Keys are opaque so a workspace never says which case it holds. A control must end with every criterion pass. A mutant's labelled criterion must be revise with a counted material finding whose document passage contains one of its markers; a criterion at revise that is neither labelled nor allowed is a false revise (at most 1 per mutant). script: the checker's own findings with no model (kind and a marker its document line contains); no other checker finding is expected.

bar.B1: Controls: C1 and C2 end with every criterion pass and overall pass.
bar.B2: Mutants: the labelled criterion is revise, with at least one counted material finding on it whose document passage contains one of the case's markers.
bar.B3: False revises: at most 1 per mutant (a criterion at revise that is neither labelled nor allowed).
bar.B4: Stability: two full runs of one grader version give the same overall verdict for all ten cases, each run meeting B1-B3, B5 and B6.
bar.B5: Files only: no WebFetch, WebSearch or Agent call by the reviewer in any run (temper events).
bar.B6: Integrity: quality.json integrity.unchanged is true in every run.
